assumptions.reference: External FX used for loan valuation and keeper trigger; not injected into pool EMA
assumptions.demand: Assume independently funded new borrowers always available up to each cap; no organic demand evidence
assumptions.debt_units: Normalized tokens at launch value; current USDT debt value changes with IRR parity
assumptions.collateral: Same 96% LP / 4% ETH, .874 LP and .67 ETH opening LTV; new receipts bought and locked, all minted tokens sold
assumptions.accounting: New LP equity contributions excluded from borrower equity P&L; quote cash is net of LP loan sale proceeds, ETH is gross collateral posted at each entry; treasury equity remains seed LP less bootstrap liability/refuels, excluding gas
